subject: Ciências
description_pt: Selecionar argumentos sobre a viabilidade da sobrevivência humana fora da Terra, com base nas condições necessárias à vida, nas características dos planetas e nas distâncias e nos tempos envolvidos em viagens interplanetárias e interestelares.

components.description_pt: Identificar as condições físicas e químicas necessárias para sustentar a vida conforme conhecida na Terra
components.description_en: Identify the physical and chemical conditions necessary to sustain life as known on Earth
components.cc_component_description: Identify evidence showing that life on Earth has co-evolved alongside Earth's systems

components.description_pt: Comparar características dos planetas do Sistema Solar com condições necessárias para sobrevivência humana
components.description_en: Compare the characteristics of planets in the Solar System with conditions required for human survival
components.cc_component_description: Compare the characteristics of different objects in the solar system, including planets, moons, and asteroids

components.description_pt: Avaliar a viabilidade de viagens interplanetárias baseada em distâncias e tempos de viagem estimados
components.description_en: Evaluate the feasibility of interplanetary travel based on distances and estimated travel times
components.cc_component_description: Analyze data on the sizes and distances of objects in the solar system

components.description_pt: Analisar argumentos sobre sobrevivência humana fora da Terra usando evidências científicas sobre ambientes planetários
components.description_en: Analyze arguments about human survival outside Earth using scientific evidence about planetary environments
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate the quality and relevance of evidence used to support competing scientific arguments

cc_matches.description: The solar system consists of the sun and a collection of objects, including planets, their moons, and asteroids that are held in orbit around the sun by its gravitational pull on them.
Compare and refine arguments based on an evaluation of the evidence presented.
Analyze and interpret data to determine scale properties of objects in the solar system.
Construct an argument based on evidence about the simultaneous coevolution of Earth’s systems and life on Earth.
